'''Z-Mu Squadron''' was a [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wing]] squadron used by the [[Zaarin coup forces|splinter government]] [[Zaarin's fleet|fleet]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]. It fought at the [[Battle of Parmel]] during Zaarin's [[Zaarin insurrection|insurrection]].

At least two [[TIE pilot]]s of the squadron were members of the [[Emperor's special reserve guard]], a cadre of elite pilots serving [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself. [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] discovered the information, which led them to believe that every level of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] hierarchy had spies.
